ruleDefinitions.name: Standard User In High Privileged Group
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect standard users login that are part of high privileged groups such as the Administrator group Note: Unmapped fields: TargetUserSid, SidList

sequences.query: (event_id = 300 AND TargetUserSid = RGX("^S\\-1\\-5\\-21\\-") AND (SidList = RGX(".*S\\-1\\-5\\-32\\-544.*") OR SidList = RGX(".*\\-500\\}.*") OR SidList = RGX(".*\\-518\\}.*") OR SidList = RGX(".*\\-519\\}.*"))) AND  NOT ((TargetUserSid = RGX("\\-500$") OR TargetUserSid = RGX("\\-518$") OR TargetUserSid = RGX("\\-519$")))
